_comment: FAKE example numbers for development only. Real SLA values are NEVER committed in the clear (decisions/0004); the real thresholds.json is gitignored and delivered at test time. Shares schema_version + provenance.kb_git_commit with catalog.tr-virt-008.json so they join.

sla.condition: All VMs on the drained worker live-migrate off it within the window (measured seconds are unit-normalized against this min gate)

checks.name: All VMs evacuated the drained node
checks.expectation: Every VM running on the drained worker is Running on a different node after the drain (none shut down or left behind)
